_comment: Guided tour for Plot Settings. Sections are CollapsibleBox panels; the live preview at the bottom re-renders on every change, so each step says what to watch for there.

steps.title: Change it here, watch it below
steps.text:
Everything in this window applies to a live preview at the bottom, before it applies to your working panels. If a setting does something you did not want, you see it on the preview first.

Settings are grouped into folding sections: backend, colours, appearance, and a pyqtgraph-only advanced section.

steps.title: The backend is the how, not the what
steps.text: Switching the rendering backend re-draws every open plot with a different engine — the curves, ranges and selections stay as they are. Try a switch and watch the preview: the data does not change, the renderer does.

await.hint: Pick a different backend and watch the preview re-render.

steps.title: Colours reach new curves first
steps.text: The palette applies to curves drawn after the change; a fit already on screen keeps its colours until it is re-plotted. Appearance settings — fonts, grid, background — apply immediately.

steps.title: The folded section is engine-specific
steps.text: The advanced section holds the options that only exist on the pyqtgraph engine: anti-aliasing, downsampling, legend and SI-prefix behaviour. They are inert under a native backend — which is why they live in their own folded section rather than the main page.

await.hint: Open the advanced section and toggle an option.
